name: markdown-studio
description: Preview Markdown files in a Markdown Studio webview experience.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run build:prod
scripts.test:ui: npm run compile && extest setup-and-run "./out/ui-test/**/*.test.js" --code_version max --mocha_config .mocharc.js

commands.title: markdown-studio: Open Preview to the Side
markdown-studio: Send to Agent (snapshot for review)

claudeMarkdownPreview.autoUpdateDebounce.description: Debounce in milliseconds for live preview updates.

claudeMarkdownPreview.enableMermaid.description: Enable Mermaid diagram rendering for fenced code blocks tagged as mermaid.

claudeMarkdownPreview.enableMath.description: Enable KaTeX rendering for math expressions.

claudeMarkdownPreview.showLineNumbers.description: Show line number gutter in code blocks.

claudeMarkdownPreview.scrollSync.description: Synchronize scroll position between the editor and the markdown-studio preview.

claudeMarkdownPreview.enableFrontmatter.description: Parse and render YAML front matter (--- blocks) as a metadata table at the top of the preview.

claudeMarkdownPreview.theme.description: Active preview theme. Built-in values are 'claude' (warm token palette), 'github' (GitHub-flavored styling), 'ergoread' (tuned for long reading sessions: near-neutral surfaces, controlled contrast) and 'executive' (presentation: elevated surfaces, display headings, vivid status colours). It may also be the name of any theme defined in claudeMarkdownPreview.customThemes. Use the Settings panel inside the preview to switch or add themes.

claudeMarkdownPreview.surfacePalettes.description: Active surface palette per theme, for themes that ship more than one. Typography, spacing and contrast are identical across a theme's palettes — only the surface colour changes. ErgoRead accepts 'warm', 'cool', 'neutral' or 'cursor'; Executive accepts 'slate' or 'graphite'. Change these from the Settings panel inside the preview (gear icon → Surface palette).

claudeMarkdownPreview.customThemes.description: User-defined preview themes. Each theme is global CSS that overrides the preview's design tokens. Manage these from the Settings panel inside the preview (gear icon → Theme → Add new theme).

name.description: Display name and id of the theme (used as the value of claudeMarkdownPreview.theme when active).

css.description: Global CSS applied last in the preview. Override design tokens under :root, body.theme-light, and body.theme-dark.

claudeMarkdownPreview.customCssPath.description: Path to a custom CSS file to load last in the preview (absolute, or relative to the workspace root). Override CSS custom properties to re-theme the preview without touching extension files.

claudeMarkdownPreview.enablePlantuml.description: Enable PlantUML diagram rendering for fenced code blocks tagged as plantuml or puml. Diagram text is sent to the configured PlantUML server URL.

claudeMarkdownPreview.plantumlServerUrl.description: Base URL of the PlantUML server used to render diagrams (e.g. https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml). The server receives the encoded diagram text; requires network access.

claudeMarkdownPreview.showComments.description: Render inline review comments (<!-- @ms-comment:… --> markers) as bubbles in the preview. Turn off to hide them from the preview entirely.

claudeMarkdownPreview.includeCommentsInE.description: Include inline comment bubbles when exporting to HTML. Off by default so exported files don't leak review notes.

claudeMarkdownPreview.commentAuthor.description: Optional author name appended to new comments as " —Name". Empty means no attribution.

//dependencies: Build inputs live in devDependencies: markdown-it and katex are compiled into dist/extension.js by esbuild, and katex's CSS/fonts plus mermaid.min.js are copied into media/vendor. Only highlight.js has to ship as real files — src/render/highlighter.ts requires grammars by computed path so that just the languages in use get loaded, and a computed require cannot be bundled. vsce packages `dependencies` only, so this keeps node_modules out of the .vsix.
